about.label: About
about.heading: From design to production: I build software that scales.
about.body:
I'm a Systems Engineer with 8+ years of experience building software for the healthcare, government, and enterprise sectors. I mainly work with Angular, Java (Spring Boot), and C# (.NET), with solid experience in databases like SQL Server and Oracle, including query optimization and stored procedures. I previously led teams as a Scrum Master, and I enjoy both writing clean code and helping a team deliver value continuously.

I currently work independently on freelance projects, managing the full product lifecycle from design to deployment.
